products.note: Legal AI assistant; contract drafting; case research; law firm data exposure; privilege concerns

profile_text.body:
Harvey is a San Francisco-based company that develops AI software for legal and professional services. According to its website, the platform is designed for law firms and corporate legal teams and is built to handle contract analysis, due diligence, compliance, and litigation support. The company describes itself as built to meet the standards of leading professional service firms, and it notes ongoing investment in publishing research and contributing to the open-source community.

The site's held facts identify Harvey AI as a legal AI assistant covering contract drafting, case research, and related workflows, with noted concerns around law firm data exposure and privilege. The company carries a California law exposure count of 175, suggesting significant regulatory and litigation surface area in that state, though no specific cases are recorded in the held data.
